physicalNotes: Radius 0.534 +/- 0.08 solar radii from Esparza-Borges et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2081 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...666A..10E/abstract): 371,504 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.54 +/- 0.08 solar masses from Esparza-Borges et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2081 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...666A..10E/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3800 +/- 100 K from Esparza-Borges et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2081 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...666A..10E/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
